resources.string: Copy GPS coordinates and place names to multiple images
Choose an image with GPS coordinates. Images without readable coordinates cannot be used as the source.
Select one or more images. Copying starts automatically; existing locations are checked one image at a time.
Results are saved as new copies in the app image directory. Original files are preserved. Coordinates and stored place names are copied without looking up an address online.
